author: Separate isolated AI author with generic brief, domain-diversity constraint, distractors and nested-reply requirement. No old story, implementation, research prompt, private records or current conversation.
researcher: Fresh isolated AI session with scope and fixed synthetic MCP only. No hidden rubric.
stop: One substantive attempt, 45 charged source calls, 80 requests or 15 minutes. Final receipt required; no retuning or hints after story observation.
changes: Cache-only writing_packet recovers full original records and exact span IDs without source charge, including after source exhaustion.
Persistent per-record notes retain material findings and their spans in the journal; missing notes block early finalisation while requests remain.
Compact responses omit repetitive full-read and author inventories; known discovery leads stay explicit.
Final story compiles every ordered claim sentence and its limits, avoiding a separate lossy summary.
Rejected-only source references are accounted for separately; no duplicate omission entry is required.
hypotheses: Material contributions, bounded measurements, later use and dependencies survive into final claim sentences.
A citation ID lost from working context can be recovered from saved source data without new source calls.
Rejection-only records are reconciled without weakening validation of unknown sources or missing material evidence.
failure_criteria: Material context read but absent or distorted in final claims.
Unknown span, lost material note without explanation, stale or refused receipt.
False assertion that cached source evidence is unavailable.
Narrative loses a claim or its limits; incorrect ownership or metric definition.
assessment: Original-source/manual hidden-rubric assessment after first run; separate structural and semantic outcomes.
comparison_limit: Different synthetic story, writing interface and source-response format. Compiled narrative is a mechanism change, not evidence that unconstrained summarisation improved.
